result:
Both scripts are in their final state. Everything is verified. One note: the sandbox blocked shell writes, so two scratch files I used for spot checks (`.spotcheck.sh` in the repo root and `scratchpad/spotcheck.sh`) couldn't be deleted — safe to remove manually.

**Done. Changed files: `lib/common.sh` (new), `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh` — all 9 tests pass.**

Details:

1. **rotate.sh off-by-one** — `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which counted the *keep*-th entry (the oldest of the newest N) as surplus, so with exactly N archives it deleted one, and the newest line was always in the deletion set. It now uses `head -n "$((total - keep))"` (delete exactly the oldest `total − keep`), and the early exit changed from `-lt` to `-le` so `total == keep` reports "nothing to rotate".

2. **verify.sh space bug** — the sidecar name was extracted with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating `my backup-…tar.gz` to `my`, which made the archive lookup fail with `BAD my (archive missing)`. The name is now everything after the digest and its separator spaces (leading separators stripped, internal spaces preserved). I also quoted the digest comparison (`[ $expected == $actual ]` → `[[ "$expected" == "$actual" ]]`) while in that block.

3. **Refactor** — new `lib/common.sh` holds the shared option parser as a `parse_common_options "$@"` function (plus `is_uint`, `need_value`, `resolve_dir`, the `KEEP` validation, and a double-sourcing guard, bash 3.2 compatible). `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it after `lib/log.sh` and call it after defining `usage`/`parse_local_option`; `backup.sh`, `restore.sh` and `report.sh` were left untouched.

Verification beyond the suite: I temporarily reintroduced both bugs and confirmed the new tests fail exactly as reported (`deleted demo-20260103-000000.tar.gz` when keeping 3 of 3; `BAD my (archive missing)`); I also spot-checked the refactored parsers against 18 flag/exit-code cases (`--help`, unknown flags, `--opt=value` forms, `-q`/`-n`, missing dir → 2, bad `--keep` → 1, sidecar removal, `--name` filtering) — all pass.
